output_dir.description: Root directory for generated media outputs (images, videos, workflows, temp are derived automatically)

comfy_dir.description: Root directory of local ComfyUI installation (input and output directories are derived automatically)

media_mcp_port.description: SSE HTTP port for unified media_mcp server

ffmpeg_bin.description: Optional FFmpeg executable path (defaults to 'ffmpeg' found in system PATH)

ffprobe_bin.description: Optional FFprobe executable path (defaults to 'ffprobe' found in system PATH)

max_video_duration.description: Maximum single-pass block diffusion duration (prefix_duration + clip_duration) in seconds
